ideas.pitch: An AI-powered regulatory and compliance tracker tailored for student incubators and early-stage startups in India, automating GST filing workflows, MSME registrations, and local entity compliance alerts.
ideas.title: RVU Startup Ecosystem Compliance Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Since the hackathon is organized by the Entrepreneurship Cell (ECell) and RV University, judges composed of entrepreneurship mentors and local founders will immediately see the high real-world value for early-stage startups.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local P2P marketplace for college students featuring milestone-based escrow payments to prevent peer-to-peer transaction fraud on campus.
ideas.title: CampusCart Secure Escrow Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses a genuine pain point for college campuses with thousands of students buying and selling textbooks, electronics, and project supplies locally.

ideas.pitch: A localized nutritional assistant that parses RV University campus mess and canteen menus daily, generating personalized macro-tracking and dietary plans for students.
ideas.title: Campus Canteen AI Nutrition & Meal Planning
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hyper-localized campus relevance with proven hackathon-winning architecture from food and nutrition tech.

ideas.pitch: Computer-vision and IoT data aggregator that tracks waste disposal bins and smart meter electricity usage across university buildings to generate automated sustainability compliance reports.
ideas.title: EcoCampus AI Waste & Energy Audit System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies rigorous multi-modal monitoring techniques seen in industrial compliance wins to a tangible campus sustainability problem that university administrators care about.

ideas.pitch: An automated patient intake, consultation summary, and trust-building platform designed for university dental hospitals and local clinics to improve appointment conversion rates.
ideas.title: AI Patient Acquisition & Trust Engine for Student Dental Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven, specialized workflow engine that won previous fast-paced sprints, adapted directly for local medical and dental practices.
